abilities.name: Navigate
abilities.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

abilities.name: Rest
abilities.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
abilities.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

abilities.name: Wait
abilities.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.

abilities.name: Pick up
abilities.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
abilities.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

abilities.name: Eat
abilities.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

abilities.name: Gather accessible material
abilities.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
abilities.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
abilities.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

abilities.name: Drop
abilities.function: Place owned units on the ground.
abilities.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

abilities.name: Give
abilities.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
abilities.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

abilities.name: Message
abilities.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
abilities.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

abilities.name: Learn a public interface
abilities.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
abilities.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
abilities.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

abilities.name: Request a capability
abilities.function: Describe an intended function and its conditions, inputs, costs and expected real effects for review.
abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward.

abilities.name: Observe wildlife
abilities.function: Quietly observe an actually visible animal for two consecutive stationary rounds.
abilities.costs: Two consecutive stationary rounds, 0.5 energy each round and ordinary metabolism. Incompatible actions, insufficient energy, death or lost visibility cancel without refund.
abilities.effects: Retain only timestamped visible species, positions and behavior. A completed observation may activate registered nature appreciation: 3 for 12 rounds, 8-round cooldown; another rewarded completion within 24 rounds gives 1 with its own 12-round expiry. Overlapping awards use their maximum, never their sum. No animal control, movement, recovery or hidden knowledge.

abilities.name: Cautious food assessment
abilities.function: Examine an owned material or consume a measured sample and monitor actual personal effects.
abilities.costs: Examine: 2 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each. Sample: 5 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each plus 1 ingestion energy, the specified 0.1–1 resource units and real proportional harm; metabolism continues. Requires health >=80; sample satiety <=90. Reserved material ages and cannot be spent twice.
abilities.effects: Retain dated sensory and exposure evidence with confounders, never a safety certification or hidden composition. Interrupted, invalidated or fatal work releases only unconsumed surviving escrow. A completed nourishing exposure without injury or another food intake may give modest relief: 1 for 6 rounds, cooldown 12, no stacking. Owned items are located at the carrier, not their old pickup coordinates.

satisfaction.name: Nature appreciation
satisfaction.rationale: Actual sustained perception of wildlife provides personal sensory engagement; no proposal, study or partial sample qualifies.

satisfaction.name: Cautious food relief
satisfaction.rationale: Modest relief follows personally experienced nourishment from completed monitored exposure without adverse or confounding evidence. Examination, labels and absence of evidence do not certify safety or earn reward.

reviews.reason: No implemented interface constructs a persistent shelter or changes exposure through occupancy. A small branch-and-grass shelter is a reasonable missing capability: nearby observed sources contain suitable construction inputs, but Sol does not currently own them. Their insulating performance must be implemented and measured, not inferred from resource names. Development supplies neither materials nor mastery and advances no simulation time.
reviews.experienceReview: Actual relief from cold can plausibly benefit Sol, but construction completion alone is not evidence of relief. Register one thermal-refuge source, deduplicated against any equivalent future comfort source. Emit shelter-comfort-qualified for the occupying actor only after 3 consecutive living, stationary rounds resting or waiting inside an active shelter, with positive measured avoided cold loss each round and a strictly lower existing cold-discomfort penalty than the unsheltered calculation. Require no starvation or health loss during that interval. Award 1 mental wellbeing, cap 1, for 6 rounds; cooldown 12 rounds from award, repeat awards allowed under the same conditions, refresh rather than stack. Reset qualification on exit, death, expired protection or failed conditions. Participants are actual occupants individually, not the builder or owner by proxy. Physical wellbeing continues to derive independently from actual hunger, health, fatigue and temperature; requesting, learning, labels and merely owning or seeing the shelter award nothing.
reviews.visualReview: Render the actual rotated frame, packed-grass covering, open entrance and shared collision outline; unfinished construction shows progress without appearing usable. Completed, expired and maintenance states must be visibly distinct. Selecting an observed shelter exposes its recipe, service time, occupancy and measured thermal contribution through shelter-exposure-measured; do not expose hidden objects or claim protection outside its interior. Show comfort feedback only on a qualified personal event. No shelter is rendered as an existing world object until real construction succeeds.
reviews.specification:
Implement shelter-construction@1 through the current conversation handoff. Public interface build-shelter: strict object schema {x:number,y:number,angle:number}, all required, additionalProperties:false; coordinates must be finite and inside world bounds. Requires mastery, 6 owned branch units and 8 owned dry-grass units, an accessible build site within 0.65 of its entrance, and 2 available energy per work round. Recipe forms a braced, interlocked frame with packed grass; no unimplemented tool or fastener is presumed. Construction takes 6 consecutive stationary rounds at 2 energy/round plus ordinary metabolism. Atomically reserve actual inputs at start; they continue aging and cannot be transferred or spent twice. Revalidate site, reach, energy and surviving inputs each round. Consume materials only on successful atomic completion; interruption, death or invalidation cancels and releases surviving escrow exactly once, to inventory if alive or the death-location ground stack otherwise. No completed object on failure.
Persist shelter ID, creator, recipe/version, position/orientation, construction tick, condition, remaining service rounds and exposure measurements. Shared geometry: rotated 2-by-2 footprint, three 0.1-thick solid walls and a front wall with a central 1.0-wide entrance; passable interior uses actual actor clearance. Reject overlap with solids, actors, reserved sites or world bounds, and require an exterior approach and navigable entrance; reserve the footprint during building without trapping or displacing actors. Navigation, collision, visibility and occupancy use these same shapes. Walking through the entrance uses navigate; rest remains rest, without an extra energy-recovery bonus.
Thermal dependency: integrate with the existing authoritative temperature/exposure update, not a cosmetic shelter flag. For a living actor whose center is inside the interior, multiply the adverse cold-exposure component by 0.5, leaving baseline ambient temperature, heat exposure and all other physiological terms unchanged. Do not multiply protection from overlapping shelters. If the current updater lacks a separable cold term, refactor it preserving all unsheltered results before activating protection. Show measured sheltered and counterfactual unsheltered cold contributions, not a promise of fixed warming. Protection lasts 160 simulation rounds after completion, then expires; the expired frame remains collidable and visibly uninsulated. Public shelter-maintain schema {target:string}, required, no extra fields: within 0.65 of entrance, reserve and consume 4 owned dry-grass units over 2 stationary rounds costing 1 energy each, with the same cancellation/death rules; completion restores 160 remaining rounds, never adds beyond 160. No healing, food, invulnerability, free rest energy or guaranteed safe temperature.
Declare and validate subscriptions for shelter-build-started, shelter-build-progress, shelter-build-completed, shelter-build-cancelled, shelter-maintenance-started, shelter-maintenance-completed, shelter-maintenance-cancelled, shelter-protection-expired, shelter-exposure-measured and shelter-comfort-qualified. Events carry actor/target IDs, tick, success, actual costs and relevant measured effects. Bind public observations, rendering and personal memory adapters to these events. Dependencies are existing inventory escrow, metabolism/death, shared geometry/navigation, temperature and wellbeing systems; implement missing adapters in this handoff. Version migration initializes an empty shelter registry and no active jobs, preserves existing resources/history/vitals, registers schemas and events before subscribers, and grants no objects, stock or mastery.

interfaces.name: Navigate
interfaces.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
interfaces.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
interfaces.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

interfaces.name: Rest
interfaces.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
interfaces.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

interfaces.name: Wait
interfaces.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.

interfaces.name: Pick up
interfaces.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
interfaces.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

interfaces.name: Eat
interfaces.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

interfaces.name: Gather accessible material
interfaces.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
interfaces.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
interfaces.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

interfaces.name: Drop
interfaces.function: Place owned units on the ground.
interfaces.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

interfaces.name: Give
interfaces.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
interfaces.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

interfaces.name: Message
interfaces.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
interfaces.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

interfaces.name: Learn a public interface
interfaces.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
interfaces.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
interfaces.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

interfaces.name: Request a capability
interfaces.function: Describe an intended function and its conditions, inputs, costs and expected real effects for review.
interfaces.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
interfaces.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward.

interfaces.name: Observe wildlife
interfaces.function: Quietly observe an actually visible animal for two consecutive stationary rounds.
interfaces.costs: Two consecutive stationary rounds, 0.5 energy each round and ordinary metabolism. Incompatible actions, insufficient energy, death or lost visibility cancel without refund.
interfaces.effects: Retain only timestamped visible species, positions and behavior. A completed observation may activate registered nature appreciation: 3 for 12 rounds, 8-round cooldown; another rewarded completion within 24 rounds gives 1 with its own 12-round expiry. Overlapping awards use their maximum, never their sum. No animal control, movement, recovery or hidden knowledge.

interfaces.name: Cautious food assessment
interfaces.function: Examine an owned material or consume a measured sample and monitor actual personal effects.
interfaces.costs: Examine: 2 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each. Sample: 5 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each plus 1 ingestion energy, the specified 0.1–1 resource units and real proportional harm; metabolism continues. Requires health >=80; sample satiety <=90. Reserved material ages and cannot be spent twice.
interfaces.effects: Retain dated sensory and exposure evidence with confounders, never a safety certification or hidden composition. Interrupted, invalidated or fatal work releases only unconsumed surviving escrow. A completed nourishing exposure without injury or another food intake may give modest relief: 1 for 6 rounds, cooldown 12, no stacking. Owned items are located at the carrier, not their old pickup coordinates.

satisfactionSources.name: Nature appreciation
satisfactionSources.rationale: Actual sustained perception of wildlife provides personal sensory engagement; no proposal, study or partial sample qualifies.

satisfactionSources.name: Cautious food relief
satisfactionSources.rationale: Modest relief follows personally experienced nourishment from completed monitored exposure without adverse or confounding evidence. Examination, labels and absence of evidence do not certify safety or earn reward.
